{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm that revenue is string and has thousands separators
# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f'Rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}')

# Now, parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# But first, check for any non-numeric strings
print('\nNon-numeric revenue values:')
non_numeric = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
non_numeric = pd.to_numeric(non_numeric, errors='coerce')
print(non_numeric.isna().sum())

# Now parse revenue properly
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if any completed orders have revenue = 999999.99
test_orders_in_completed = (completed_df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f'Completed orders with revenue = 999999.99: {test_orders_in_completed}')

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_df['revenue_numeric'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}')"}
